title: Decision-Sufficient Posterior Approximation
summary: We investigate the consequences of requiring a posterior approximation to preserve a specified downstream decision problem. A target posterior $P$ and loss determine a regret geometry on actions, a baseline approximation $Q_0$ determines the forward-Kullback-Leibler information required to induce action changes, and a restricted approximation family $\mathcal{Q}$ determines which such changes are available.
